description: v0.1.90 (C392 L0): manifest harnessPackages cases (MANIFEST §10.1, M-HP-1..4). Each case replaces `harnessPackages` in examples/notes.manifest.json and, when `manifestId` is given, its `id` (M-HP-5: only the `knowledge` app's `lcm-x` may take the context-engine slot). `valid` cases pass the schema and every rule. `invalid` cases are refused with `code` (harness_package_invalid) under the pointer /harnessPackages; `by: schema` = manifest.schema.json already refuses it, `by: validator` = only the manifest package rule refuses it (the schema accepts it). Commit ids are illustrative, not real pins. The manifest package (sdk repo) tests against this file.

valid.what: Hermes package: Knowledge hooks + LCM-X at a pinned commit (L1 shape)

upstreams.name: lcm-x
upstreams.dataOnAgentMachine: Session transcripts and summaries in a SQLite file under the Hermes home of this agent (HERMES_HOME/lcm). Nothing leaves the agent machine.
upstreams.erase: Purge works per session only. A per-person purge is not possible: Knowledge lists the affected sessions and the operator purges them.
